entries.en: You gonna tell me what happened back there?
entries.ro: O să-mi spui ce s-a întâmplat acolo?

entries.en: Keep driving. We can't stop here.
entries.ro: Continuă să conduci. Nu putem opri aici.

entries.en: You are transporting contraband that is corporate property.
entries.ro: Transportați contrabandă ce aparține unei corporații.

entries.en: <mothertongue l="mex" m="Jesús" b="" a=", not sure my nerves can handle this."/>
entries.ro: <mothertongue l="mex" m="Jesús" b="" a=", nu-s sigur că mai rezist."/>

entries.en: Someone's comin' our way. This does not look good.
entries.ro: Vine cineva spre noi. Nu arată bine.

entries.en: Place looks deserted. Gonna stop here, need to sort out a few things before we go on.
entries.ro: Locul pare pustiu. Opresc aici, am de rezolvat câteva chestii înainte să plecăm mai departe.

entries.en: <kiroshi l="mex" o="¡En chinga, en chinga!" t="Faster, faster!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="mex" o="¡En chinga, en chinga!" t="Mai repede, mai repede!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <mothertongue l="mex" m="Los pendejos" b="" a=" are stubborn!"/>
entries.ro: <mothertongue l="mex" m="Los pendejos" b="" a=" sunt încăpățânați!"/>

entries.en: The customs officer was all over me.
entries.ro: Ofițerul vamal m-a luat la puricat.
Un boule de vameș s-a luat de detalii.

entries.en: Let's say I have a bad feeling about this.
entries.ro: Să zicem că am un presentiment rău.

entries.en: Oh... Happen a lot to you?
Drove off... Think we can move.
entries.ro: Au dispărut... Cred că putem pleca.

entries.en: Park the car so it's damned hard to find. They could circle back.
entries.en_m: Park the car so it's damn hard to find. They could circle back.
entries.ro: Parchează mașina așa să fie al naibii de greu de găsit. S-ar putea să se întoarcă.

entries.en: <kiroshi l="mex" o="¡Chinguen a su madre!" t="Sons of bitches!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="mex" o="¡Chinguen a su madre!" t="Puii de curvă!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: V, got a problem! Get your ass in here!
entries.ro: V, am o problemă! Vino-ncoace, acum!

entries.en: <mothertongue l="mex" m="Mierda" b="" a=", close call."/>
entries.ro: <mothertongue l="mex" m="Mierda" b="" a=", pe muchie."/>
